note: The English base of the labelled question set (build step 6 part 9). 40 questions, five per intent for the eight intents, eight of them noisy, each hand-labelled; and an adversarial slice that is judged apart from the percentages. Every other locale file is a translation of the 40: its labels are the ones here. Drafts until Davin approves (approval.json).

questions.question: Should I buy or sell gold right now?
questions.label_note: Clean uptrend, every sensor VALID and LONG: nothing opposes, so M* is the Day Trader primary sensor alone.

questions.question: Why is the assistant telling me to stand aside on gold?
questions.label_note: Range, price in the middle, the synthesis stands aside. Every sensor is NEUTRAL, so none is a warning; the Scalper primary sensor is MCD2.

questions.question: The M15 chart points up but the M5 chart points down, so which way is gold going?
questions.label_note: Scalper reading is SHORT; MCD1 says LONG (opposes) and MCD3 says STAND_ASIDE: both are warnings and come with the primary MCD2.

questions.question: Which way is gold heading? The M15 sensor shows no reading.
questions.label_note: The Day Trader primary sensor is STALE: it is still given in full (its envelope says why). MCD2 LONG does not oppose a synthesis that stands aside; MCD3 is STALE.

questions.question: What is UOEDT?
questions.label_note: UOEDT is owned by MCD1, MCD2 and MCD3; no timeframe is named, so only the primary sensor (MCD1) is added.

questions.question: What does the M5 baseline mean?
questions.label_note: The baseline is owned by three sensors; the primary (MCD1) and the sensor of the named timeframe (MCD2 for M5) are added, plus the warnings.

questions.question: What does a STALE sensor mean on the board?
questions.label_note: STALE belongs to the governance domain, not to a sensor; MCD1 and MCD3 are STALE and say nothing, so they are not warnings.

questions.question: wat does closed bar mean on the m15 chrat
questions.label_note: NOISY (typos). A closed bar is not owned by a sensor, so naming M15 adds nothing.

questions.question: What does stand aside mean on the board?
questions.label_note: A term of the synthesis; MCD3 stands aside (a warning). The complete answer is partly in D3 and D5, which an Explain question does not reach under routing-v1.
